LightningComponentBundle.description: Feed and Related tabs for an ARC record page, rebuilt from Lightning's record page. Read-only, no Files tab. Reads through ArcRelatedListController and ArcCaseFeedController, rendering its own posts and cards.

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: Object whose record page this sits on. The record id is resolved against it.

property.name: feedPageSize
property.label: Feed Page Size
property.description: How many feed posts to show. Capped at 50 server-side.
